name: R.E.M.

whyMatters.en: Athens, Georgia college-rock four formed in 1980. Rickenbacker jangle and opaque verse scaled to 90s alternative mass; Losing My Religion (1991) and Everybody Hurts (1992) sit beside grunge as another US alt-radio face.
whyMatters.zh: 乔治亚雅典学院摇滚四人组，1980 年成立。Rickenbacker jangle 与含糊主歌扩到 90 年代 alternative 大众面；《Losing My Religion》（1991）与《Everybody Hurts》（1992）与 grunge 并列，作另一美国 alt 电台面孔。

lyricQuotes: That's me in the corner / That's me in the spotlight losing my religion

shortBio.en: Athens jangle-alt four, 1980–2011. Losing My Religion mandolin hit; Everybody Hurts ballad as 90s alt mass face.
shortBio.zh: 雅典 jangle-alt 四人，1980–2011。《Losing My Religion》曼陀林热单；《Everybody Hurts》谣曲作 90 年代 alt 大众面孔。

body.en:
R.E.M. formed in Athens, Georgia, in 1980. Murmur (1983) and Document (1987) establish Buck’s arpeggiated Rickenbacker, Stipe’s opaque delivery, Mills high harmony, and Berry’s dry drums—college-rock writing before major-label scale.

Out of Time (1991) and Automatic for the People (1992) are the mass-alt hinge: Losing My Religion mandolin riff, Everybody Hurts string-backed ballad. Berry left in 1997; the band continued as a trio until 2011. Craft is jangle and mid-tempo clarity, not grunge soft-loud.
body.zh:
R.E.M. 于 1980 年在乔治亚雅典成立。《Murmur》（1983）与《Document》（1987）确立 Buck 琶音 Rickenbacker、Stipe 不透明吐字、Mills 高和声、Berry 干鼓——大厂体量之前的学院摇滚写法。

《Out of Time》（1991）与《Automatic for the People》（1992）是大众 alt 铰链：《Losing My Religion》曼陀林 riff、《Everybody Hurts》弦乐谣曲。Berry 于 1997 年离队；乐队三人继续至 2011。写法是 jangle 与中速清晰，而非 grunge soft-loud。

note.en: Document breakthrough single; Buck arpeggio and Stipe hook.
note.zh: 《Document》突破单曲；Buck 琶音与 Stipe 钩子。

note.en: Mandolin riff as 90s alt-radio face; from Out of Time.
note.zh: 曼陀林 riff 作 90 年代 alt 电台面孔；出自《Out of Time》。

note.en: String ballad from Automatic for the People.
note.zh: 出自《Automatic for the People》的弦乐谣曲。

title.zh: Jangle 学院摇滚到大众 alt

body.en:
Buck’s Rickenbacker arpeggios and Stipe’s non-literal verses define early R.E.M., before distortion became the main alt language.

Losing My Religion put a mandolin-led single on global alt radio in 1991 beside Nevermind.

Everybody Hurts uses ballad dynamics without soft-loud grunge form.
body.zh:
Buck 的 Rickenbacker 琶音与 Stipe 非字面主歌定义早期 R.E.M.，当时失真尚未成为主要 alt 语言。

《Losing My Religion》在 1991 年把曼陀林主导单曲送上全球 alt 电台，与《Nevermind》并列。

《Everybody Hurts》使用谣曲动态，不用 grunge soft-loud 曲式。

body.en:
Stipe, Buck, Mills, and Berry held from Murmur through Automatic for the People. Berry retired in 1997 after an aneurysm; the trio era (Up, Reveal) continued without a permanent drummer as a named bandmember.

Peak citation period is Berry-era 1987–1994.

Rhythm-section stability is the lineup story; there was no classic guitarist split.
body.zh:
Stipe、Buck、Mills 与 Berry 从《Murmur》撑到《Automatic for the People》。Berry 于 1997 年因动脉瘤退休；三人期（《Up》《Reveal》）继续，无正式鼓手成员替代。

巅峰引用期是 Berry 时代 1987–1994。

阵容故事是节奏组稳定；没有经典吉他手分裂。

title.zh: 与 grunge 并列的美国 alternative

body.en:
Pixies and Nirvana share the 80s/90s US indie-to-major path; R.E.M. supply jangle and lyric opacity on that map.

Radiohead and later UK/US alt cite Automatic-era ballad craft.

College-radio infrastructure is concrete: I.R.S. years, then Warner mass.
body.zh:
Pixies 与 Nirvana 共享 80/90 年代美国 indie 到大厂路径；R.E.M. 在该地图上提供 jangle 与歌词不透明。

Radiohead 与后来英美 alt 引用 Automatic 期谣曲写法。

学院电台基建具体：I.R.S. 年头，再到华纳大众。
